nodes.label: Logo Universidad del Cauca (vertical)
nodes.description: Official vertical institutional logo of Universidad del Cauca. Features the university coat of arms (heraldic shield with ornate baroque flourishes) showing a hand holding a flaming torch, surrounded by the Latin motto 'POSTERIS LVMEN MORITVRVS EDAT'. Below the shield is a ribbon banner inscribed '1827 UNIVERSIDAD DEL CAUCA' (founding year). The wordmark 'Universidad del Cauca' appears in large bold blue serif typography beneath the crest. Color scheme: deep royal blue on white background. Used as a branding/identity asset in the DeporteParaTodos Angular frontend application.
